comments.value: I realize this could be merged into https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/vote-kick-reason now after I made it, but I didn't see it when I looked, I'm sorry. However, I think I offer some other ideas that might be useful so please review it before you merge.

details:
Currently, votekicks have several issues or abilities to be expanded:

1: In a large instance, if a votekick starts, it will rarely pass because most people do not know the reasoning for it. Allowing an advanced votekick system wherein you can submit a message/reason for starting a votekick with possibly pre-set reasons [I see it used as a simple attack for personal reasons very rarely, but it does happen] and also the ability to opt-in on being shown who is starting it to everyone, by the votekicker's request would benefit it as well.

2: Votekicks still have an issue where they simply do not function as intended. Perhaps expanding instance moderator tools to anonymously track who voted yes, no, or abstained from the voting would be helpful in this case so if it fails, the moderator could step in. Heck, a Moderator separate tab/Hud would be amazing in general.

3: Votekicks will not appear if you have the user blocked (ie if they're a malicious client user, wherein you'd vote yes), as far as I know these abstaining are automatically counted as a no, which isn't a good or intended solution. Users should still be able to decide on votekicks for people they have blocked, even if it's overwhelmingly going to be yes. 

4: Votekicks not appearing for people who freshly joined an instance will also interfere with votekicks and count as an abstain, which is arguably a no. If an event has an influx of griefers and there's only votekicks being relied on, this can quickly become an overwhelming problem because of how many forced no votes there end up being.

I think a few of these would be handled by implementing a moderator hud for instance moderators/creators.
title: Expanded votekick system
